message.content:
In this repository, search for an interface/abstraction related to "markdown" processing (e.g. rendering markdown to HTML, parsing markdown, etc). I need to know:

1. The interface/abstract type definition (file path, name) for markdown processing.
2. Which concrete implementation(s) of that interface actually execute at runtime (not test doubles/mocks) — file paths and type names.
3. Who constructs/instantiates these concrete implementations (constructor call sites, factory functions, DI wiring) — file paths and line context.
4. Which components/structs/classes hold a reference to the interface type (i.e., depend on the abstraction rather than the concrete type) — file paths and field names.

Search broadly: grep for "Markdown", "markdown", "MarkdownRenderer", "MarkdownProcessor", "MarkdownService", etc. Look for interface definitions (Go interfaces, TS interfaces, Java interfaces, Python ABCs/Protocols, etc). Report file:line citations for everything you find. Be thorough — check the whole repo, not just one language/package.

content.text:
All uses of `markdown.NewService(...)` in non-test files use the real `service` struct (there is no mock/fake implementation in the codebase — `markdown.Service` has exactly one production implementation). Note: `memopayload.NewRunner`/`Runner` struct is defined but not actually instantiated anywhere in the codebase (not even wired into `server.go`); `RebuildMemoPayload` (the package-level function it wraps) is what's actually called directly with `s.MarkdownService`.

Here's the full picture.

## 1. Interface / abstraction definition

**`markdown.Service`** — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:31-55`

```go
type Service interface {
    ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)
    ExtractTags(content []byte) ([]string, error)
    ExtractProperties(content []byte) (*storepb.MemoPayload_Property, error)
    RenderMarkdown(content []byte) (string, error)   // AST -> markdown text
    RenderHTML(content []byte) (string, error)       // markdown -> HTML
    GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)
    ValidateContent(content []byte) error
    RenameTag(content []byte, oldTag, newTag string) (string, error)
}
```
Doc comment (lines 27-30) notes it wraps goldmark for parsing/extraction; HTML rendering server-side is mainly for RSS since the frontend renders markdown itself via `react-markdown`.

## 2. Concrete runtime implementation

**`*markdown.service`** (unexported struct) — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:58-60`
```go
type service struct {
    md goldmark.Markdown
}
```
Wraps `github.com/yuin/goldmark`. Methods implementing `Service`: `ExtractTags` (143), `ExtractProperties` (193), `RenderMarkdown` (244, delegates to `renderer.MarkdownRenderer` at line 250), `RenderHTML` (255), `GenerateSnippet` (264), `ValidateContent` (349), `ExtractAll` (356), `RenameTag` (425).

There is no mock/fake in the repo (`grep -l mock/Mock/Fake` on files referencing `markdown.Service` returns nothing) — this is the sole implementation used everywhere, including in tests, via the real constructor.

Internally, `RenderMarkdown` uses a second concrete (non-interface) helper type, `*renderer.MarkdownRenderer` — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:15-24` (struct) and `Render` method (line 27) — but this is not itself behind an interface; it's just an AST-to-markdown-text serializer used internally by `service`.

## 3. Constructor / factory and call sites

Factory: **`markdown.NewService(opts ...Option) Service`** — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:85-113` (functional-options constructor; builds a `goldmark.Markdown` with GFM + optional `TagExtension`/`MentionExtension`, returns `&service{md: md}`).

Runtime (non-test) call sites:
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51` — inside `NewAPIV1Service(...)`:
  ```go
  markdownService := markdown.NewService(
      markdown.WithTagExtension(),
      markdown.WithMentionExtension(),
  )
  ```

## Frontend (TypeScript) note

On the web side there is **no equivalent interface/abstraction** for markdown processing. `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/MemoMarkdownRenderer.tsx` renders markdown directly via the third-party `ReactMarkdown` component (from `react-markdown`) configured with remark/rehype plugins — there's no custom `MarkdownRenderer`-style interface with swappable implementations; the component itself is the concrete rendering entry point. `MarkdownRenderContext` (`/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/MarkdownRenderContext.tsx:3`, `interface MarkdownRenderContextValue`) is just a React context value shape (compact mode flags, mention resolution, etc.), not a markdown-processing abstraction. So the Go `markdown.Service` interface described above is the only genuine interface/abstraction for markdown processing in this repo.
